svg.title: Tclslang object model architecture
svg.desc: Verilog source is parsed by the Slang frontend into a tree object, which exposes modules, ports, cells, connections and drivers as first-class Tcl objects, with drivers resolving to const, var or net subtypes.
svg.text: Gray = input · Purple = C++ / Slang layer · Teal = Tcl object model · Coral = driver subtypes
